checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Face structure, expression and pose are essentially identical; only skin tone is warmer.

must.item: Curly hair, sweater, head-and-shoulders framing retained
must.why: Same composition. The hair turned reddish-brown instead of dark black, but it is still curly. The sweater is grey with a pink cast.
Trees, path, lawn and bench remain, with an autumn-orange cast.

must.item: Warm faded grading and visible grain give a 1970s look
must.why: Strong amber and red tint, faded blacks, light leaks and grain. It is somewhat heavy-handed.

faults.what: Hair colour shifted from near-black to reddish auburn, partly from the heavy colour cast.
Grade is very saturated and orange-red, with red light-leak edges. Less faded than requested.
The assistant's reply says it could not preview the result, so the recognisability claim is unverified.

summary: A convincing 1970s film-still look with the face, composition and park intact; the grade is strong and saturated and turns her dark hair reddish.
